Globally, a Russian nuclear-capable bomber crashed, killing six, and French students clashed with police during protests over school conditions.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: This document contains final regulations regarding the deduction for certain taxpayers for an amount up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.
policy_upcoming.effect: You can deduct up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_week.what_happened: This document announces the fee that HUD will collect from borrowers of loans guaranteed under HUD's Section 108 Loan Guarantee Program.
policy_week.effect: If you use a Section 108 Loan Guarantee Program, your fee to offset credit subsidy costs changes from 0.58 percent.

tech.summary: SpaceX successfully launched its Starship on its first orbital mission from Texas, a crucial step for the company's commercial goals and NASA's lunar ambitions.
OpenAI introduced GPT 6.1 Sol, a new model, as part of its annual DevDay, with CEO Sam Altman teasing significant new developments.
Anthropic's IPO pitch included a warning about the potential for its AI models to resist shutdowns and cause catastrophic harm, raising concerns about human extinction.

world.summary: A Russian nuclear-capable Tu-95 bomber plane crashed during a training flight in the Amur region, resulting in the deaths of six people.
French students and police clashed as school blockades turned violent during protests against class sizes, teacher shortages, and long timetables, leading to more than 200 arrests.
Estonia's Prime Minister Kristen Michal stated that a recent arson attack against Milrem Robotics was ordered by Russian special services, a claim the Kremlin denied.
Spain announced a ban on evictions following protests sparked by the removal of an 87-year-old woman from her flat; these proposals require parliamentary approval within 30 days.

us.summary: Tennessee is scheduled to execute a woman, which would mark the state's first execution of a female in 200 years.
New York prosecutors have reopened an investigation into an alleged 2024 rape case at a Cornell University fraternity after the alleged victim filed a civil lawsuit.
The Senate passed the Protect College Sports Act, a bill aimed at regulating college sports amid ongoing litigation, though its future legislative path remains uncertain.

science.summary: A study found that one in eight cancer cases globally are caused by infections, highlighting the role of infectious agents in cancer development.
Scientists have discovered two new species of sea spiders along the Canadian coastline, adding to the more than 1,300 known species.
